record.question: Nalanda University is considered a great centre of learning in ancient India. Which of the following statements is INCORRECT?
options: It was established during the Mauryan period under Chandragupta Maurya
It attracted scholars from India and abroad, and offered a wide range of subjects
It was an inclusive center of learning that also trained monks and scholars of various Buddhist traditions
It was a residential university providing free education and accommodation
